subject.title: Anaheim Elementary School District Board, Trustee Area 2

text: I am a teacher, educational leader, and former school board president with over 30 years serving students across Orange County. A product of California public schools, I hold a Doctor of Education in Educational Leadership from CSU Fullerton, plus advanced degrees in special education and social sciences.

I've taught elementary, middle, and high school, plus adult education and juvenile detention programs, and spent two decades as a special education teacher, co-teaching leader, and department chair supporting English learners and students with disabilities.

I served eight years as an elected trustee of the Anaheim Elementary School District, including two terms as Board President. I led passage of Measure J, a $318 million bond approved by 73% of voters to rebuild aging schools—delivered on time and within budget. I worked to streamline administrative spending, direct resources to classrooms, and helped establish a Budget Advisory Committee that cut costs while expanding bilingual education and enrichment programs.

I'm running for Area 2 Trustee to keep public education focused on students, families, and teachers—not administrative bloat. Schools should be community-centered, transparent, and accountable. My priorities: empowering educators, strengthening parent partnerships, and ensuring every child has safe schools, quality instruction, and the chance to thrive.
